📰 General

Thanksgiving Storm Cripples Northeast and Midwest with Flooding and Power Outages •

A significant storm impacted the Northeast and Midwest on Thanksgiving Day, bringing widespread disruptions. The storm caused numerous power outages across several states, affecting thousands of residents. The historic postponement of New York City’s Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade was announced due to hazardous conditions. Heavy rainfall led to significant flooding, impacting travel plans and local infrastructure. Authorities are continuing to assess the full extent of the damage and coordinate recovery efforts.

🌍 World

Putin Inspects New Nuclear Submarine Amidst Kremlin’s Escalating Security Rhetoric •

President Putin visited the recently launched nuclear submarine, the “Prince Vladimir,” as part of a display of Russia’s naval capabilities. Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov asserted that Russia faces a heightened security environment, citing numerous external threats. The Kremlin’s statement emphasizes the importance of the nation’s nuclear deterrent, which includes land-based intercontinental ballistic missiles. This visit comes as tensions remain high regarding Russia’s military actions and international relations.

🦅 US

Joe Milton Shines in Eagles Debut: Stunning Stats Fuel Comeback Victory •

Joe Milton, an Eagles rookie quarterback, made a remarkable impact in his third career start on Thursday night. He completed 21 of 31 passes for 331 yards, showcasing impressive passing ability. Milton also contributed a crucial 15-yard rushing touchdown, adding to the team’s offensive success. The Eagles ultimately secured a 39-38 victory after a dramatic comeback win fueled by Milton’s performance.

💰 Business

US Air Force Cloud One System Compromised, Threatening Sensitive Data •

Hackers gained unauthorized access to the US Air Force’s Cloud One computing platform, a critical system used across the military. The breach reportedly exposed a significant amount of sensitive information, marking the latest cybersecurity incident affecting government servers. Investigators are currently working to determine the full scope of the intrusion and the specific data accessed. The Air Force is implementing enhanced security measures following the incident, aiming to prevent future vulnerabilities.

💻 Technology

Apple Teases iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2 Launch Plans •

Apple is reportedly planning the release of the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e models, anticipated for a launch in early 2027. The MacRumors Show discussed these upcoming devices, highlighting the expected February or March release timeframe. Details regarding the iPhone 18e remain scarce, but it is expected to be a more affordable option. The iPhone Air 2 is also slated for introduction alongside these new iPhones.

🎭 Entertainment

Villeneuve Expresses Disappointment Over Simultaneous ‘Avengers’ and ‘Dune’ Releases •

Director Denis Villeneuve voiced his dissatisfaction with Disney’s decision to release “Avengers: Doomsday” on the same December 18th weekend as the third “Dune” installment. Villeneuve stated he was “deeply disappointed” by the overlapping release dates, indicating a potential conflict for audience attention. The interview, conducted for Time Magazine, highlighted concerns about the impact on box office performance for both films. Disney’s choice was made to maximize theatrical revenue for the “Avengers” film.

🏅 Sports

Steelers Players React to Rodgers’ Comments, McCarthy Addresses Team Concerns •

Following Aaron Rodgers’ controversial remarks regarding head coach Mike McCarthy, Pittsburgh Steelers players are reportedly focused on preparing for upcoming games. Sources indicate a desire to move forward and minimize the distraction caused by the situation. McCarthy addressed the team, emphasizing the importance of remaining professional and concentrating on football strategy. The team is attempting to navigate the fallout while maintaining their competitive goals for the remainder of the season.

🔬 Science

New Website Reveals Amateur Surveillance of Homes Across the Globe •

A recently launched website is providing access to live video feeds from security cameras installed in homes worldwide. The platform allows anyone to view snapshots of residential properties, raising serious privacy concerns. The site’s operators claim it’s a “snapshot” service, but the accessibility of live footage is alarming. Authorities are investigating the platform’s origins and potential misuse of the collected data.

🩺 Health

Body Shape Reveals Health Risks: New Research Links Body Form to Potential Health Issues •

Recent research suggests a correlation between body shape and increased risk of certain health conditions. Specifically, individuals with an apple-shaped body – characterized by a larger waist circumference – demonstrate a higher likelihood of developing type 2 diabetes and heart disease. Conversely, those with a pear-shaped body, featuring wider hips and slimmer waistlines, appear to have a lower risk of these conditions. The study emphasizes the importance of considering body composition alongside traditional risk factors for comprehensive health assessments.
